notes.title: The demo version is now available to everyone.
notes.notes:
Great news! 
The demo version of our exciting adventure game "Prince Adventures" is now available for you on Steam! Immerse yourself in the magical world of the Magical Oasis and, together with Prince William, begin your journey in the fight against the evil that has overtaken these magical lands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860514/88a48c427b32c82188c5d883d274cbe29aec4576.png

We look forward to your feedback and thoughts on the game. Your support and advice will help us improve the project and make it even better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860514/882f59ff112dc32f822c776fda72ceb3f280e9d7.png

Join us on an adventure and help us restore harmony to the magical world! Try the demo today and let us know what you think!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860514/3419fcd2f593ec8afcec6f766affb8e49cba7f95.png
